name: oddbout
description: Make, review and register your ODDBOUT fighter in one plugin: the hosted ODDBOUT tools (Google sign-in) are inside, and PC or Dots workspaces use the same skill.

interface.shortDescription: Make, review and register your fighter
interface.longDescription: Connect your ODDBOUT account with Google and make a fighter in one place. Ask ODDBOUT to make one from your words or pictures (hosted generation: two looks, then the eleven motions, then registration), have it made on your own PC as a generation host, or create it yourself in your PC or a supported per-user Dots workspace with Node.js 22.12+, Python 3.11+ and your own generation account. Review looks and animation groups, resume unfinished work, register the approved package and manage your fighters with the same connected account. A chat without execution or file delivery cannot package animations itself; hosted generation does that for you.
defaultPrompt: Make an ODDBOUT fighter for me from this idea.
Resume my fighter and show what still needs review.

publication.release_notes: 0.6.0: One plugin. The hosted ODDBOUT MCP (https://mcp.oddbout.com/mcp, Google sign-in) is inside the plugin instead of a separately added connector, so the plugins list shows one ODDBOUT; hosted generation (request, looks, motions, register), community hosts and the creation skill work from it. Install this and remove the older ODDBOUT plugin and the custom ODDBOUT connector; sign in with Google once. 0.5.5: Pinned Dots VM entry and resume, Grok subscription route, private original delivery, plugin-cache launcher repair. VM creation acceptance remains separate from installation and unit checks. 0.5.4: A running generation can be stopped and has a time limit, so a stuck provider no longer blocks the motion; readiness checks run together and check for kit updates at most every five minutes; unchanged files are not hashed again. 0.5.3: Packing and gait checks run faster; an approved device sign-in survives a network failure and finishes with --device-wait; recording a version after an interrupted copy works; saving the session retries a briefly locked file on Windows; updates that change the validator or tools ask for a restart. 0.5.2: A session lock left by an interrupted run is reclaimed instead of blocking the session; parallel tool calls wait their turn; a finished generation is always recorded; game-context failures say whether the kit needs an update; profile text limits match the package contract. 0.5.1: fighter:pack and fighter:gait run again (0.5.0 left out a module they import), and a package that fails file validation is no longer written to its folder. 0.5.0: The sprite-gen engine is now sprite-gen-agent (Alex Kim's sprite-gen 3.4.0 with the motion engine); no hash patch step. 0.4.0: One ODDBOUT entry point for creation, grouped review and registration. Run the same workspace tools from a PC or a supported Dots workspace without a separate local MCP plugin. Use the existing connected ODDBOUT account for registration; preserve local projects and selected versions.
